# Tests that fail today on a leg of ci-matrix.yml, so that leg can gate on
# everything else. One pytest node id per line; "#" starts a comment. Every unit
# leg deselects the whole file; a line naming a test that leg does not run is
# harmless. This is a debt list, not an allowlist: fix the test, then delete its
# line. tests/ci/test_ci_matrix_workflow.py fails when a line names a test that no
# longer exists, so the list cannot rot.
#
# macOS: temp dirs resolve under /private/var, which the credential redactor
# rewrites, so these assert on a path that is already redacted.
tests/security/test_credentials.py::test_cleanup_warns_when_the_askpass_unlink_fails
tests/security/test_credentials.py::test_secure_overwrite_warns_when_the_file_cannot_be_opened
tests/security/test_credentials.py::test_wipe_warns_when_a_registered_path_cannot_be_removed
tests/security/test_credentials.py::test_cleanup_warns_when_the_askpass_file_survives
tests/security/test_credentials.py::test_cleanup_warns_when_rmtree_reports_a_failure
tests/enterprise/test_support_bundle.py::test_support_bundle_resolves_audit_path_from_root
# macOS: the probe script uses `exec {fd}>&-`, which the system bash 3.2 lacks.
tests/analyzers/test_sandbox_execution.py::test_payload_environment_restore_is_literal_and_private
# macOS: timing on the runner (a slow streaming driver); watch for flakiness.
tests/agents/test_activity_watchdog.py::test_codex_driver_survives_a_slow_but_streaming_run
# `config tracing` sometimes renders at 80 columns although these tests set
# COLUMNS=400, so the table truncates the path that holds the file name. It hit
# different tests on each py3.12 shard and never on py3.13, so it is order- or
# worker-dependent rather than version-specific.
tests/cli/test_tracing_config_sources.py::test_config_tracing_lists_the_files_doctor_lists
tests/cli/test_tracing_config_sources.py::test_config_tracing_and_config_explain_agree_about_the_local_overlay
tests/cli/test_tracing_config_sources.py::test_without_a_local_overlay_only_the_committed_file_contributes
tests/cli/test_tracing_config_sources.py::test_the_local_overlay_is_ignored_on_ci_like_the_loader
tests/cli/test_tracing_config_sources.py::test_an_existing_mergecraft_config_is_the_sole_contributor
tests/cli/test_tracing_config_sources.py::test_an_explicit_config_flag_wins_before_the_shared_resolver
